fixes.rationale_full: wouldServeGet and the no-slash 301 branch of serveFrom now apply the mount's containment + link check (the former listable(), renamed reachable() and widened to files) before deciding, and the index file is checked the same way. A refused or outside-pointing symlink file or directory now gets 404 for POST (no Allow) and GET (no 301), matching FR-STATIC-002 AC-5 and FR-STATIC-006 AC-2; with allowSymlinks(true) inside links still get 405/301 and outside links 404.

fixes.red_failure: AssertionError: expected:<200> but was:<500> (the head was committed before the failed open)
fixes.rationale_full: TinyHttpdFeatures.sendFile opens the RandomAccessFile and seeks before ex.commit, so a missing/unreadable file throws with the response unstarted. To keep the abort check and single-start rule ahead of the open (AdapterSurfaceTest FR_ENGINE_010_AC2_featureHooksShareTheCommitLockAbortCheckAndSingleStart), TinyHttpdExchange.start() was split into requireStartable() + set, and sendFile calls requireStartable() under the exchange lock before the open. Lock is kept (sendFile stays synchronized).

StaticMount.freeze() now keeps DefaultStaticOptions.copy(), a private copy (lists/maps copied, accessors already unmodifiable) reachable only through the frozen mount and published by StaticHandler's final fields. A configurer that kept its StaticOptions reference can no longer change index, MIME, SPA or listing of a running mount or race worker iteration. The copy's setters were not made to throw: nothing outside the mount holds it.

StaticPath.check refuses a decoded segment holding a backslash with 400 like '/', on every platform, closing the Windows-JVM bypass of the hidden-path 404 under allowSymlinks(true). docs/api/static.md lists %5C among the refused encodings.

fixes.red_failure: compile error: cannot find symbol method resolverTap(...) on StaticHandler (no seam to observe the resolver calls)
fixes.rationale_full: Added a package-private test seam: FileResponder.ResolverTap (own interface, no java.util.function for API 21) held as a volatile instance field of StaticHandler and handed per request by Dispatcher to DefaultResponse; static mounts and res.file/res.download wrap their resolver through FileResponder.tapped. Instance state only, so FR-APP-002 AC-2's no-mutable-static scan still holds. The engine-free test installs a real recording ResourceResolver and asserts length, etag, modified and open are each called on a FileResourceResolver delegate for a static mount GET, res.file and res.download.
